title: Jasper vs. Copy.ai: Which is best? [2026]
summary: Jasper AI and Copy.ai are two of the most popular AI productivity tools on the market—but they serve different purposes. Here's how they compare.
body_markdown:
**Jasper**


**Copy.ai**


**Target user**


Marketing teams


Go-to-market teams (sales, marketing, operations)


**Development status**


Monthly product releases


Last product update June 2025; Copy.ai was acquired by Fullcast and is being folded into its platform


**Content creation**


Chat interface plus Canvas workspace and document editor; 100+ prebuilt marketing agents for blogs, social product descriptions, and campaign copy


AI chat interface with content templates; Content Agent Studio, available on higher-tier plans, lets you create your own content agents


**Automation**


Marketing agents across all plans; Grid, GEO Agent, image pipelines, translation agents, and custom agents are available on Jasper Business


GTM workflows for account research, deal health, call insights, and content generation (on the Agents plan and up)


**Brand consistency**


Jasper IQ offers brand voices, audience profiles, style guides, and brand compliance tools to keep messaging consistent


Brand voice and knowledge base; less granular than Jasper IQ


**Image generation**


Yes; automated image pipelines on the Business plan


No


**Team collaboration**


Enforces brand standards across your whole team; Canvas workspace offers comments, real-time editing, and campaign organization tools


5 seats on Chat, 10 seats on Agents, 75+ seats on Enterprise plans; Tables makes it easy to share data


**Data and integrations**


Native integrations with Semrush, Salesforce, Asana, Webflow, Slack, Google Workspace, and more; connects with thousands of other apps via Zapier


Web scraping, email verification, CRM connections, and automated data collection; connects with thousands of apps via Zapier


**Pricing structure**


Starts at $59/month billed annually, for one seat; teams will need a custom quote for the Business plan; 7-day free trial


Starts at $24/month billed annually for basic chat functionality; Agents plan, at $211/month, adds AI workflows; Enterprise plan starts at $1,000/month
